name: torch_contest_l2_027_olmo3_yarn
author: torch
description: Olmo-3-32B GQA + YARN RoPE + Q/K RMSNorm (40/8 GQA, h=5120). Q/K norm is **full-dim** (across (n_heads*head_dim)) not per-head — must be done before reshape. YARN cos/sin derived from inv_freq + position_ids + attention_factor. FlashInfer rmsnorm + SDPA + custom attention_mask.

sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import flashinfer.norm as fn

NQ = 40
NKV = 8
HD = 128
H = 5120
Q_OUT = NQ * HD
KV_OUT = NKV * HD


def _rotate_half(x):
    half = x.shape[-1] // 2
    return torch.cat((-x[..., half:], x[..., :half]), dim=-1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run(hidden_states, position_ids, attention_mask,
        q_proj_weight, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight, o_proj_weight,
        q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, inv_freq, rms_norm_eps,
        attention_factor, scaling):
    b, s, _ = hidden_states.shape

    q_flat = F.linear(hidden_states, q_proj_weight)   # (b, s, Q_OUT)
    k_flat = F.linear(hidden_states, k_proj_weight)
    v_flat = F.linear(hidden_states, v_proj_weight)

    # Full-dim RMSNorm on Q and K (reference normalizes the (b*s, Q_OUT) tensor)
    q_normed = fn.rmsnorm(q_flat.reshape(-1, Q_OUT).contiguous(), q_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, s, NQ, HD)
    k_normed = fn.rmsnorm(k_flat.reshape(-1, KV_OUT).contiguous(), k_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, s, NKV, HD)
    q = q_normed.transpose(1, 2)
    k = k_normed.transpose(1, 2)
    v = v_flat.view(b, s, NKV, HD).transpose(1, 2)

    # YARN RoPE
    inv_e = inv_freq[None, :, None].float().expand(b, -1, 1)
    pos_e = position_ids[:, None, :].float()
    freqs = (inv_e @ pos_e).transpose(1, 2)
    emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
    cos = (emb.cos() * attention_factor).unsqueeze(1).to(q.dtype)
    sin = (emb.sin() * attention_factor).unsqueeze(1).to(q.dtype)
    q = q * cos + _rotate_half(q) * sin
    k = k * cos + _rotate_half(k) * sin

    out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=attention_mask, scale=scaling, enable_gqa=True)
    out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().reshape(b, s, H)
    return F.linear(out, o_proj_weight)
